command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "700880d383b0d50a27d9f195ed2cc24325feff98" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')
needles=['leave','rejoin','steering','DEVICE_REBOOT','DEVICE_FIRST_START','BDB_SIGNAL_STEERING','factory_reset','reset_factory','permit_join']
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.h')):
    text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    ls=text.splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if any(n.lower() in l.lower() for n in needles)]
    if not hits: continue
    print('===',p,'===')
    shown=set()
    for i in hits:
        lo=max(0,i-5); hi=min(len(ls),i+14)
        key=(lo,hi)
        if key in shown: continue
        shown.add(key)
        print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
PY
